subject.title: Google Chat: replyToMode: "off" does not suppress thread replies

question: Should maintainers treat https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/89790 as the canonical fix path for this issue, or wait for broader Google Chat thread-routing work?
rationale: The issue is still valid on main, but an open closing PR already owns the narrow repair while broader overlapping work is also open.

options.title: Use the focused closing PR
options.body: Review and land https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/89790 after its remaining proof or maintainer-review gate is satisfied.

options.title: Wait for broader thread-routing work
options.body: Keep this issue open but pause the focused closing path if maintainers want the broader thread-preservation branch to become canonical.

options.title: Request a new replacement
options.body: Ask for a fresh narrow replacement only if the existing closing PR becomes unmaintainable or no longer matches current main.

recommendation.title: Use the focused closing PR
recommendation.body: Review and land https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/89790 after its remaining proof or maintainer-review gate is satisfied.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is tied to the landed Google Chat thread-reply option support that made this behavior visible and is a good routing candidate for choosing the canonical fix path.
